commits.msg: Birthday surprise: tour-styled card flow, reveal, music
3D stage: LED panel wall, mirror balls, ball-burst reveal
Pre-compile the reveal and lighten per-frame panel work
Music-reactive stage and disco ball light rays
Link-preview video rendered from the 3D stage
Smaller link-preview video
Link-preview video without text, reframed on the mirror balls
Reveal: collapse the wall down and away instead of through the camera
Hold on "Because…" over the rainbow wall before the reveal
Journey: distinct scene per card (lone ball, party, inside the ball, crowd, LED tunnel)
Give mirror balls a dark core so the tower doesn't show through the tile gaps
Float our photos inside the mirror ball on the 'best thing' card
Refine journey: crowd wave/floods/beat, tunnel rings close in, inside text waits
Photos arrive with the swallow, before the text
Per-scene sound, crowd roar, finale-synced burst, name on the wall, stadium bowl, countdown and note
Crowd: real silhouettes with raised phones instead of glow dots; drop the wave
Crowd: near-black tiered stands, thinner rim, softer spots, 30fps crowd updates
Crowd: photoreal stadium plate with live phone lights and house-up fade, real applause loop; venue back to main
Reveal: just the title and 'Te amo.'
Fix hitches: keep the sphere light in the scene (light-count change rebuilt every material), preload and upload later scenes' images, warm hidden pieces with culling off
Portrait 4:5 link preview so iMessage shows the tall card
Revert "Portrait 4:5 link preview so iMessage shows the tall card"
Link preview: landscape again, rethought as a story loop (lone ball, lights on, blackout) with a party-frame still
Link preview: its own landscape set
Reveal: drop the Te amo line
Link preview: our photos as drifting polaroids
Softer scene audio, quieter crowd, For Nati
Decoy opening: a cheesy love-story slideshow that glitches to black
Slideshow: real Canon in D and CC0 sound effects, way more cheese
Slideshow: dots and tap prompt return for Hey babe
Slideshow: a different set piece per photo
LED wall: NATHALIE IT'S YOUR BIRTHDAY, a word at a time
LED wall words step with the kick
Slideshow: first birthday as a mom — crib mobile and Mama set pieces
Party wall words sit under the card, clear of the balls; song starts far-off under Hey babe
Party wall: IT'S / YOUR / BIRTHDAY / NATHALIE, one big word per kick stepping down the wall
Party wall: NATI, in big condensed type
Fix first-visit hitches: warm the whole scene, not just hidden pieces
Finale: run-up under Because…, burst on the second climax
Finale: burst on the beat drop after the opening build
Finale: come in just before the drums, shorter Because…
Card: "You didn't really think… cheesy slideshow, did you?"
Loader: cursive Nati title card with hearts, WordArt tap to start
Pink Safari bars for the loader and slideshow, black after the glitch
Finale: ball drops on the drum run at 0:21.94, bursts on the hit at 0:24.25
Revert pink Safari bars: back to black
Hide the progress dots from first paint, not just once the slideshow starts
Loader: real loading bar; download the songs and crowd in full before the tap
Loader: the heart is the dot on Nati's i
Slideshow photos from in-memory copies, so new images never wait on the server
Finale: burst on the last hit of the drum run (0:23.73)
Finale: music in at 0:19 under Because…, ball bursts open at 0:23
Finale: in at 0:17, wall comes apart at 0:19.2 with a camera swing through flying balls and glitter, settling on the ball for the burst
Finale: wall becomes a mosaic of the night, panels fly past the camera on the percussion, then the tower and ball
Finale continues on from the tunnel: rings go rainbow, then mosaic, then fly apart into the tower
Finale flight: spinning tunnel, a field of our photos and mirror balls, landing on the column and ball; drop the camera tilt on hits
Flight polish: smooth speed curve and soft stop, eased hand-off, tunnel unzips along its spin, field looms out of the dark and swirls, gentler tower rise
Compile the floating photos during warm-up so the party scene doesn't hitch
Finale flight: lights-on field reveal, streaming pass-bys, arcing camera, built-up landing
Finale flight: no constant-speed stretches (accelerate down the tunnel, one long ease-out after)
Finale: keep accelerating through a longer tunnel and field, brake hard onto the settled column and ball; dim (not black) before the lights; dev ?finale jump
Finale: tunnel panels keep their rainbow looks (drop the photo mosaic and its percussion detector); softer chrome on the field's balls
Finale flight rides the song: a push on every beat, speed stepping up on the beats, the drum fill shoving us in, settling only onto the hit
Finale flight: one smooth building run, a weaving line past big mirror-ball landmarks, denser field and neon hoops to fly through
Finale flight: gentler weave, smoother look-ahead, calmer spins
Keep the dev tap-gate skip out of production
Smoother hand-off into the finale: finale track in at 15.5 on a 1.6s equal-power crossfade, tunnel dips to rainbow while still gliding, Because… lands as it lights, flight takes off at 17
No kick zoom punch during the finale flight (it read as stutter); eased back in after the hit
Because… lands half a second later (17.05), just after take-off
Finale track comes in half a second later (16.0)
Hard cut from the last card into the finale: songs swap the moment the finale plays, screens cut to rainbow
Because… holds until the tunnel opens (one shared FINALE_OPEN), no dead second before the field
Finale flight takes off on the cut (16.0); tunnel opens at 18.4 and the field is far longer in distance (more props, hoops, bends) flown at full speed
Finale starts at 0:18.40 from a trimmed file, so nothing seeks at the cut
Photos page: replace any of the 12 photos, cropped around a tapped focus point
Photos page: upload under /tools (the bb tunnel reserves /__ paths)
Swap in Nati's picks for photos 2, 6, 7 and 12; rebuild the link preview
Finale waits paused at its start: stop it on 'playing' after the unlock, re-cue on every card, rewind before the cut if needed
Finale: "Because…" comes up over the still tunnel as the song fades out, then the finale fades in as we take off
